                                       .withColumn("salted_key", col("key"))
    
    df_right_skewed = df_right_exploded.filter(col("is_skewed") == 1) \
                                       .withColumn("salt_array", array([lit(i) for i in range(num_salts)])) \
                                       .withColumn("salt", explode(col("salt_array"))) \
                                       .withColumn("salted_key", concat(col("key"), lit("_"), col("salt")))
    
    df_right_salted = df_right_normal.union(
        df_right_skewed.select(df_right_normal.columns)
    )
    
    # Perform join on salted keys
    df_join_salted = df_left_salted.join(
        df_right_salted,
        df_left_salted.salted_key == df_right_salted.salted_key,
        "inner"
    ).select(
        df_left_salted["id"].alias("left_id"),
        df_left_salted["key"],
        df_left_salted["value"],
        df_left_salted["amount"],
        df_right_salted["id"].alias("right_id"),
        df_right_salted["description"],
        df_right_salted["quantity"]
    )
    
    count_salted = df_join_salted.count()
    time_salted = time.time() - start_time
    
    print(f"Salted join completed in {time_salted:.2f} seconds")
    print(f"Result count: {count_salted}")
    print(f"Performance improvement: {((time_baseline - time_salted) / time_baseline * 100):.2f}%")
    
    # Strategy 3: Isolated Broadcast for Skewed Keys
    print("\n4. Isolated Broadcast Pattern:")
    print("-" * 60)
    start_time = time.time()
    
    # Separate skewed and normal data
    df_left_skewed = df_left.filter(col("key").isin(skewed_keys))
    df_left_normal = df_left.filter(~col("key").isin(skewed_keys))
    
    df_right_skewed = df_right.filter(col("key").isin(skewed_keys))
    df_right_normal = df_right.filter(~col("key").isin(skewed_keys))
    
    # Broadcast join for skewed keys (if right side is small enough)
    from pyspark.sql.functions import broadcast
    df_join_skewed = df_left_skewed.join(
        broadcast(df_right_skewed),
        "key",
        "inner"
    )
    
    # Normal join for non-skewed keys
    df_join_normal = df_left_normal.join(df_right_normal, "key", "inner")
    
    # Union results
    df_join_isolated = df_join_skewed.union(df_join_normal)
    count_isolated = df_join_isolated.count()
    time_isolated = time.time() - start_time
    
    print(f"Isolated broadcast join completed in {time_isolated:.2f} seconds")
    print(f"Result count: {count_isolated}")
    
    # Strategy 4: Adaptive Query Execution (AQE) with Skew Join
    print("\n5. Adaptive Query Execution (AQE) Skew Join:")
    print("-" * 60)
    start_time = time.time()
    
    # AQE will automatically detect and handle skew during execution
    df_join_aqe = df_left.join(df_right, "key", "inner")
    count_aqe = df_join_aqe.count()
    time_aqe = time.time() - start_time
    
    print(f"AQE join completed in {time_aqe:.2f} seconds")
    print(f"Result count: {count_aqe}")
    
    # Strategy 5: Bucketing for Skew Mitigation
    print("\n6. Bucketing Strategy:")
    print("-" * 60)
    
    # Save data as bucketed tables
    bucket_path_left = "/tmp/bucketed_left"
    bucket_path_right = "/tmp/bucketed_right"
    
    # Create bucketed tables
    df_left.write.mode("overwrite") \
           .bucketBy(20, "key") \
           .sortBy("key") \
           .saveAsTable("bucketed_left", path=bucket_path_left)
    
    df_right.write.mode("overwrite") \
            .bucketBy(20, "key") \
            .sortBy("key") \
            .saveAsTable("bucketed_right", path=bucket_path_right)
    
    print("Bucketed tables created successfully")
    
    # Read bucketed tables
    df_left_bucketed = spark.table("bucketed_left")
    df_right_bucketed = spark.table("bucketed_right")
    
    start_time = time.time()
    df_join_bucketed = df_left_bucketed.join(df_right_bucketed, "key", "inner")
    count_bucketed = df_join_bucketed.count()
    time_bucketed = time.time() - start_time
    
    print(f"Bucketed join completed in {time_bucketed:.2f} seconds")
    print(f"Result count: {count_bucketed}")
    
    # Strategy 6: Custom Partitioner with Skew Awareness
    print("\n7. Custom Skew-Aware Partitioning:")
    print("-" * 60)
    
    # Assign custom partition based on skew
    df_left_custom = df_left.withColumn(
        "custom_partition",
        when(col("key").isin(skewed_keys), 
             # Distribute skewed keys across multiple partitions
             (hash(col("key"), col("id")) % 10))
        .otherwise(
             # Normal keys get fewer partitions
             (hash(col("key")) % 5) + 10
        )
    )
    
    df_left_custom = df_left_custom.repartition(15, "custom_partition")
    
    # Check partition distribution
    partition_dist = df_left_custom.rdd.mapPartitionsWithIndex(
        lambda idx, it: [(idx, sum(1 for _ in it))]
    ).collect()
    
    print("Custom partition distribution:")
    for idx, count in sorted(partition_dist):
        print(f"  Partition {idx}: {count} records")
    
    # Summary
    print("\n" + "=" * 80)
    print("PERFORMANCE SUMMARY")
    print("=" * 80)
    print(f"Baseline join:          {time_baseline:.2f}s")
    print(f"Salted join:            {time_salted:.2f}s ({((time_baseline-time_salted)/time_baseline*100):.1f}% improvement)")
    print(f"Isolated broadcast:     {time_isolated:.2f}s ({((time_baseline-time_isolated)/time_baseline*100):.1f}% improvement)")
    print(f"AQE join:               {time_aqe:.2f}s ({((time_baseline-time_aqe)/time_baseline*100):.1f}% improvement)")
    print(f"Bucketed join:          {time_bucketed:.2f}s ({((time_baseline-time_bucketed)/time_baseline*100):.1f}% improvement)")
    
    # Cleanup
    spark.sql("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS bucketed_left")
    spark.sql("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS bucketed_right")
    
    spark.stop()

## 4. Dynamic Rebalancing Pattern

```python
"""
Dynamic Rebalancing Pattern
Purpose: Adjust partitioning dynamically based on runtime conditions and data characteristics
Use Case: When data characteristics change during processing or are unknown upfront
"""

from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
from pyspark.sql.functions import *
from pyspark.sql.types import *
import time
import random

def dynamic_rebalancing_pattern():
    """
    Demonstrates dynamic rebalancing based on runtime metrics and adaptive strategies
    """
    
    spark = SparkSession.builder \
        .appName("DynamicRebalancingPattern") \
        .config("spark.sql.adaptive.enabled", "true") \
        .config("spark.sql.adaptive.coalescePartitions.enabled", "true") \
        .config("spark.sql.adaptive.coalescePartitions.minPartitionNum", "1") \
        .config("spark.sql.adaptive.advisoryPartitionSizeInBytes", "64MB") \
        .config("spark.dynamicAllocation.enabled", "true") \
        .getOrCreate()
    
    print("=" * 80)
    print("DYNAMIC REBALANCING PATTERN")
    print("=" * 80)
    
    # Create dataset with varying characteristics
    data = []
    for i in range(20000):
        category = f"cat_{random.randint(1, 50)}"
        subcategory = f"subcat_{random.randint(1, 200)}"
        value = random.randint(1, 10000)
        timestamp = i
        
        data.append((i, category, subcategory, value, timestamp))
    
    schema = StructType([
        StructField("id", IntegerType(), True),
        StructField("category", StringType(), True),
        StructField("subcategory", StringType(), True),
        StructField("value", IntegerType(), True),
        StructField("timestamp", IntegerType(), True)
    ])
    
    df = spark.createDataFrame(data, schema)
    
    # Strategy 1: Statistics-Based Dynamic Partitioning
    print("\n1. Statistics-Based Dynamic Partitioning:")
    print("-" * 60)
    
    def calculate_optimal_partitions(df, target_partition_size_mb=64):
        """Calculate optimal number of partitions based on data size"""
        # Get approximate size of DataFrame
        df.cache()
        count = df.count()
        
        # Estimate size (rough approximation)
        # Assuming average row size of 100 bytes
        estimated_size_mb = (count * 100) / (1024 * 1024)
        
        optimal_partitions = max(1, int(estimated_size_mb / target_partition_size_mb))
        
        print(f"
```python
Estimated data size: {estimated_size_mb:.2f} MB")
        print(f"Optimal partitions calculated: {optimal_partitions}")
        
        return optimal_partitions
    
    optimal_parts = calculate_optimal_partitions(df)
    df_optimized = df.repartition(optimal_parts)
    
    print(f"DataFrame repartitioned to {optimal_parts} partitions")
    
    # Strategy 2: Workload-Aware Dynamic Rebalancing
    print("\n2. Workload-Aware Dynamic Rebalancing:")
    print("-" * 60)
    
    class DynamicRebalancer:
        """Dynamic rebalancer that adjusts based on workload characteristics"""
        
        def __init__(self, spark_session):
            self.spark = spark_session
            self.execution_times = []
        
        def analyze_workload(self, df):
            """Analyze workload characteristics"""
            stats = df.agg(
                count("*").alias("total_records"),
                countDistinct("category").alias("distinct_categories"),
                countDistinct("subcategory").alias("distinct_subcategories"),
                avg("value").alias("avg_value"),
                stddev("value").alias("stddev_value")
            ).collect()[0]
            
            return {
                'total_records': stats['total_records'],
                'distinct_categories': stats['distinct_categories'],
                'distinct_subcategories': stats['distinct_subcategories'],
                'avg_value': stats['avg_value'],
                'stddev_value': stats['stddev_value']
            }
        
        def determine_partitioning_strategy(self, workload_stats):
            """Determine best partitioning strategy based on workload"""
            total_records = workload_stats['total_records']
            distinct_cats = workload_stats['distinct_categories']
            distinct_subcats = workload_stats['distinct_subcategories']
            
            # Decision logic
            if distinct_cats < 10:
                strategy = "hash_partition_category"
                num_partitions = distinct_cats * 2
            elif distinct_subcats > 100:
                strategy = "hash_partition_subcategory"
                num_partitions = min(200, distinct_subcats)
            else:
                strategy = "round_robin"
                num_partitions = max(4, total_records // 5000)
            
            return strategy, num_partitions
        
        def apply_dynamic_partitioning(self, df):
            """Apply dynamic partitioning based on analysis"""
            print("  Analyzing workload...")
            stats = self.analyze_workload(df)
            
            print(f"  Workload Statistics:")
            print(f"    Total records: {stats['total_records']}")
            print(f"    Distinct categories: {stats['distinct_categories']}")
            print(f"    Distinct subcategories: {stats['distinct_subcategories']}")
            
            strategy, num_partitions = self.determine_partitioning_strategy(stats)
            
            print(f"  Selected strategy: {strategy}")
            print(f"  Target partitions: {num_partitions}")
            
            if strategy == "hash_partition_category":
                return df.repartition(num_partitions, "category")
            elif strategy == "hash_partition_subcategory":
                return df.repartition(num_partitions, "subcategory")
            else:
                return df.repartition(num_partitions)
        
        def monitor_and_adjust(self, df, operation_func):
            """Monitor execution and adjust if needed"""
            start_time = time.time()
            
            # Execute operation
            result = operation_func(df)
            result.cache()
            count = result.count()
            
            execution_time = time.time() - start_time
            self.execution_times.append(execution_time)
            
            print(f"  Execution time: {execution_time:.2f}s")
            
            # Check if rebalancing needed
            if len(self.execution_times) > 1:
                avg_time = sum(self.execution_times[:-1]) / len(self.execution_times[:-1])
                if execution_time > avg_time * 1.5:
                    print("  ⚠ Performance degradation detected, rebalancing recommended")
                    return self.apply_dynamic_partitioning(result), True
            
            return result, False
    
    rebalancer = DynamicRebalancer(spark)
    df_dynamic = rebalancer.apply_dynamic_partitioning(df)
    
    # Strategy 3: Adaptive Coalescing During Pipeline
    print("\n3. Adaptive Coalescing During Pipeline:")
    print("-" * 60)
    
    def adaptive_pipeline(df):
        """Pipeline that adaptively adjusts partitions at each stage"""
        
        # Stage 1: Filter (reduces data size)
        print("  Stage 1: Filtering...")
        df_filtered = df.filter(col("value") > 1000)
        count_filtered = df_filtered.count()
        print(f"    Records after filter: {count_filtered}")
        
        # Adaptive coalesce based on remaining data
        reduction_ratio = count_filtered / df.count()
        if reduction_ratio < 0.5:
            new_partitions = max(2, int(df_filtered.rdd.getNumPartitions() * reduction_ratio))
            print(f"    Coalescing to {new_partitions} partitions (reduction: {reduction_ratio:.2%})")
            df_filtered = df_filtered.coalesce(new_partitions)
        
        # Stage 2: Aggregation (further reduces data)
        print("  Stage 2: Aggregation...")
        df_agg = df_filtered.groupBy("category", "subcategory").agg(
            count("*").alias("count"),
            avg("value").alias("avg_value"),
            sum("value").alias("total_value")
        )
        count_agg = df_agg.count()
        print(f"    Records after aggregation: {count_agg}")
        
        # Further coalesce for small result set
        if count_agg < 1000:
            print(f"    Coalescing to 1 partition (small result set)")
            df_agg = df_agg.coalesce(1)
        
        # Stage 3: Enrichment (might increase data size)
        print("  Stage 3: Enrichment...")
        df_enriched = df_agg.withColumn("value_category", 
            when(col("avg_value") > 7000, "high")
            .when(col("avg_value") > 4000, "medium")
            .otherwise("low")
        )
        
        # Repartition if needed for downstream processing
        if count_agg > 5000:
            new_parts = min(20, count_agg // 500)
            print(f"    Repartitioning to {new_parts} for downstream processing")
            df_enriched = df_enriched.repartition(new_parts)
        
        return df_enriched
    
    start_time = time.time()
    df_pipeline_result = adaptive_pipeline(df)
    df_pipeline_result.cache()
    final_count = df_pipeline_result.count()
    pipeline_time = time.time() - start_time
    
    print(f"\n  Pipeline completed in {pipeline_time:.2f}s")
    print(f"  Final record count: {final_count}")
    
    # Strategy 4: Runtime Metrics-Based Rebalancing
    print("\n4. Runtime Metrics-Based Rebalancing:")
    print("-" * 60)
    
    def monitor_partition_metrics(df):
        """Monitor partition-level metrics"""
        partition_info = df.rdd.mapPartitionsWithIndex(
            lambda idx, iterator: [(idx, sum(1 for _ in iterator))]
        ).collect()
        
        partition_sizes = [size for _, size in partition_info]
        
        if not partition_sizes:
            return None
        
        metrics = {
            'num_partitions': len(partition_sizes),
            'total_records': sum(partition_sizes),
            'avg_size': sum(partition_sizes) / len(partition_sizes),
            'min_size': min(partition_sizes),
            'max_size': max(partition_sizes),
            'std_dev': (sum((x - sum(partition_sizes)/len(partition_sizes))**2 
                           for x in partition_sizes) / len(partition_sizes)) ** 0.5
        }
        
        # Calculate coefficient of variation
        if metrics['avg_size'] > 0:
            metrics['cv'] = metrics['std_dev'] / metrics['avg_size']
        else:
            metrics['cv'] = 0
        
        return metrics, partition_info
    
    def should_rebalance(metrics, cv_threshold=0.5, size_ratio_threshold=3.0):
        """Determine if rebalancing is needed based on metrics"""
        if metrics is None:
            return False, "No metrics available"
        
        # Check coefficient of variation
        if metrics['cv'] > cv_threshold:
            return True, f"High variation (CV={metrics['cv']:.2f} > {cv_threshold})"
        
        # Check max/min ratio
        if metrics['min_size'] > 0:
            size_ratio = metrics['max_size'] / metrics['min_size']
            if size_ratio > size_ratio_threshold:
                return True, f"High size ratio ({size_ratio:.2f} > {size_ratio_threshold})"
        
        # Check for empty partitions
        if metrics['min_size'] == 0:
            return True, "Empty partitions detected"
        
        return False, "Partitions are balanced"
    
    # Monitor initial state
    print("  Initial partition state:")
    metrics, partition_info = monitor_partition_metrics(df_dynamic)
    print(f"    Number of partitions: {metrics['num_partitions']}")
    print(f"    Average partition size: {metrics['avg_size']:.2f}")
    print(f"    Min/Max partition size: {metrics['min_size']}/{metrics['max_size']}")
    print(f"    Coefficient of variation: {metrics['cv']:.2f}")
    
    needs_rebalance, reason = should_rebalance(metrics)
    print(f"    Rebalancing needed: {needs_rebalance} - {reason}")
    
    if needs_rebalance:
        print("  Applying rebalancing...")
        df_rebalanced = df_dynamic.repartition(metrics['num_partitions'])
        
        metrics_after, _ = monitor_partition_metrics(df_rebalanced)
        print(f"    After rebalancing:")
        print(f"      Coefficient of variation: {metrics_after['cv']:.2f}")
        print(f"      Min/Max partition size: {metrics_after['min_size']}/{metrics_after['max_size']}")
    
    # Strategy 5: Multi-Stage Dynamic Rebalancing
    print("\n5. Multi-Stage Dynamic Rebalancing:")
    print("-" * 60)
    
    class MultiStageRebalancer:
        """Rebalancer that tracks and optimizes across multiple stages"""
        
        def __init__(self):
            self.stage_metrics = []
        
        def execute_stage(self, df, stage_name, operation, target_partitions=None):
            """Execute a stage with automatic rebalancing"""
            print(f"\n  Executing: {stage_name}")
            
            # Pre-stage metrics
            pre_metrics, _ = monitor_partition_metrics(df)
            print(f"    Pre-stage partitions: {pre_metrics['num_partitions']}")
            print(f"    Pre-stage CV: {pre_metrics['cv']:.2f}")
            
            # Execute operation
            start_time = time.time()
            result_df = operation(df)
            result_df.cache()
            count = result_df.count()
            exec_time = time.time() - start_time
            
            # Post-stage metrics
            post_metrics, _ = monitor_partition_metrics(result_df)
            
            # Record metrics
            stage_info = {
                'stage': stage_name,
                'execution_time': exec_time,
                'record_count': count,
                'pre_cv': pre_metrics['cv'],
                'post_cv': post_metrics['cv'],
                'pre_partitions': pre_metrics['num_partitions'],
                'post_partitions': post_metrics['num_partitions']
            }
            self.stage_metrics.append(stage_info)
            
            print(f"    Execution time: {exec_time:.2f}s")
            print(f"    Result records: {count}")
            print(f"    Post-stage CV: {post_metrics['cv']:.2f}")
            
            # Decide if rebalancing needed for next stage
            if target_partitions:
                optimal_parts = target_partitions
            else:
                # Calculate based on data size
                if count < 1000:
                    optimal_parts = 1
                elif count < 10000:
                    optimal_parts = max(2, post_metrics['num_partitions'] // 2)
                else:
                    optimal_parts = post_metrics['num_partitions']
            
            # Apply rebalancing if beneficial
            if optimal_parts != post_metrics['num_partitions']:
                print(f"    Rebalancing to {optimal_parts} partitions for next stage")
                result_df = result_df.repartition(optimal_parts) if optimal_parts > post_metrics['num_partitions'] \
                           else result_df.coalesce(optimal_parts)
            
            return result_df
        
        def print_summary(self):
            """Print summary of all stages"""
            print("\n  Multi-Stage Execution Summary:")
            print("  " + "-" * 76)
            print(f"  {'Stage':<25} {'Time(s)':<10} {'Records':<12} {'CV Before':<12} {'CV After':<12}")
            print("  " + "-" * 76)
            
            for info in self.stage_metrics:
                print(f"  {info['stage']:<25} {info['execution_time']:<10.2f} "
                      f"{info['record_count']:<12} {info['pre_cv']:<12.2f} {info['post_cv']:<12.2f}")
            
            total_time = sum(info['execution_time'] for info in self.stage_metrics)
            print("  " + "-" * 76)
            print(f"  Total execution time: {total_time:.2f}s")
    
    # Execute multi-stage pipeline

    # Strategy 6: Feedback Loop Rebalancing
    print("\n6. Feedback Loop Rebalancing:")
    print("-" * 60)
    
    class FeedbackLoopRebalancer:
        """Rebalancer with feedback loop for continuous optimization"""
        
        def __init__(self, initial_partitions=8):
            self.current_partitions = initial_partitions
            self.performance_history = []
            self.learning_rate = 0.3
        
        def execute_with_feedback(self, df, operation, iteration):
            """Execute operation and adjust based on feedback"""
            print(f"\n  Iteration {iteration}:")
            print(f"    Current partitions: {self.current_partitions}")
            
            # Repartition based on current setting
            df_partitioned = df.repartition(self.current_partitions)
            
            # Execute and measure
            start_time = time.time()
            result = operation(df_partitioned)
            result.cache()
            count = result.count()
            exec_time = time.time() - start_time
            
            # Get partition metrics
            metrics, _ = monitor_partition_metrics(result)
            
            # Calculate performance score (lower is better)
            # Combines execution time and partition balance
            balance_penalty = metrics['cv'] * 10  # Penalize imbalance
            performance_score = exec_time + balance_penalty
            
            self.performance_history.append({
                'iteration': iteration,
                'partitions': self.current_partitions,
                'exec_time': exec_time,
                'cv': metrics['cv'],
                'score': performance_score
            })
            
            print(f"    Execution time: {exec_time:.2f}s")
            print(f"    CV: {metrics['cv']:.2f}")
            print(f"    Performance score: {performance_score:.2f}")
            
            # Adjust partitions based on feedback
            if len(self.performance_history) > 1:
                prev_score = self.performance_history[-2]['score']
                current_score = performance_score
                
                if current_score < prev_score:
                    # Performance improved, continue in same direction
                    print(f"    ✓ Performance improved")
                    adjustment = 1
                else:
                    # Performance degraded, reverse direction
                    print(f"    ✗ Performance degraded, adjusting strategy")
                    adjustment = -1
                
                # Calculate new partition count
                change = int(self.current_partitions * self.learning_rate * adjustment)
                self.current_partitions = max(1, min(32, self.current_partitions + change))
                
                print(f"    Next iteration will use {self.current_partitions} partitions")
            
            return result
        
        def find_optimal(self, df, operation, max_iterations=5):
            """Find optimal partitioning through iterations"""
            print("  Finding optimal partitioning through feedback...")
            
            for i in range(1, max_iterations + 1):
                self.execute_with_feedback(df, operation, i)
            
            # Find best configuration
            best = min(self.performance_history, key=lambda x: x['score'])
            print(f"\n  Optimal configuration found:")
            print(f"    Best partitions: {best['partitions']}")
            print(f"    Best execution time: {best['exec_time']:.2f}s")
            print(f"    Best CV: {best['cv']:.2f}")
            
            return best['partitions']
    
    # Test feedback loop
    feedback_rebalancer = FeedbackLoopRebalancer(initial_partitions=8)
    
    def sample_operation(df):
        return df.groupBy("category", "subcategory").agg(
            count("*").alias("count"),
            avg("value").alias("avg_value")
        ).filter(col("count") > 5)
    
    optimal_partitions = feedback_rebalancer.find_optimal(
        df.sample(0.5),  # Use sample for faster iterations
        sample_operation,
        max_iterations=4
    )
    
    # Strategy 7: Predictive Rebalancing
    print("\n7. Predictive Rebalancing:")
    print("-" * 60)
    
    def predictive_rebalancing(df, operation_type="aggregation"):
        """Predict optimal partitioning based on operation type and data characteristics"""
        
        # Analyze data characteristics
        sample_df = df.sample(0.1)
        sample_df.cache()
        
        stats = sample_df.agg(
            count("*").alias("count"),
            countDistinct("category").alias("distinct_cats"),
            approx_count_distinct("subcategory").alias("approx_distinct_subcats")
        ).collect()[0]
        
        # Estimate full dataset size
        estimated_total = stats['count'] * 10
        distinct_cats = stats['distinct_cats']
        distinct_subcats = stats['approx_distinct_subcats']
        
        print(f"  Predictive Analysis:")
        print(f"    Estimated total records: {estimated_total}")
        print(f"    Distinct categories: {distinct_cats}")
        print(f"    Approx distinct subcategories: {distinct_subcats}")
        
        # Predict optimal partitions based on operation type
        if operation_type == "aggregation":
            # For aggregation, partition by number of groups
            predicted_partitions = min(32, max(4, distinct_cats * 2))
            print(f"    Operation type: Aggregation")
            print(f"    Predicted optimal partitions: {predicted_partitions}")
            print(f"    Strategy: Partition by grouping key")
            
        elif operation_type == "join":
            # For joins, balance between parallelism and shuffle cost
            predicted_partitions = min(64, max(8, estimated_total // 1000))
            print(f"    Operation type: Join")
            print(f"    Predicted optimal partitions: {predicted_partitions}")
            print(f"    Strategy: Balance parallelism and shuffle")
            
        elif operation_type == "filter":
            # For filters, fewer partitions initially, coalesce after
            predicted_partitions = min(16, max(4, estimated_total // 2000))
            print(f"    Operation type: Filter")
            print(f"    Predicted optimal partitions: {predicted_partitions}")
            print(f"    Strategy: Conservative partitioning with post-filter coalesce")
            
        else:  # default
            predicted_partitions = min(32, max(4, estimated_total // 1000))
            print(f"    Operation type: Default")
            print(f"    Predicted optimal partitions: {predicted_partitions}")
        
        return predicted_partitions
    
    # Apply predictive rebalancing for different operations
    predicted_parts_agg = predictive_rebalancing(df, "aggregation")
    df_predicted_agg = df.repartition(predicted_parts_agg, "category")
    
    predicted_parts_filter = predictive_rebalancing(df, "filter")
    df_predicted_filter = df.repartition(predicted_parts_filter)
    
    # Final Summary
    print("\n" + "=" * 80)
    print("DYNAMIC REBALANCING SUMMARY")
    print("=" * 80)
    print("\nKey Techniques Demonstrated:")
    print("1. Statistics-based partition calculation")
    print("2. Workload-aware dynamic partitioning")
    print("3. Adaptive coalescing during pipeline execution")
    print("4. Runtime metrics-based rebalancing")
    print("5. Multi-stage rebalancing with tracking")
    print("6. Feedback loop optimization")
    print("7. Predictive rebalancing based on operation type")
    
    print("\nBest Practices:")
    print("- Monitor partition metrics (CV, size distribution)")
    print("- Adjust partitions between pipeline stages")
    print("- Use coalesce after filtering operations")
    print("- Use repartition when data size increases")
    print("- Consider operation type when choosing partition count")
    print("- Implement feedback loops for iterative workloads")
    
    spark.stop()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    dynamic_rebalancing_pattern()

"""
Proactive Rebalancing Pattern
Purpose: Anticipate and prevent imbalance before it occurs
Use Case: Prevent performance degradation in long-running jobs and streaming applications
"""

from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
from pyspark.sql.functions import *
from pyspark.sql.types import *
from pyspark.sql.window import Window
import time
import random
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

def proactive_rebalancing_pattern():
    """
    Demonstrates proactive rebalancing strategies to prevent performance issues
    """
    
    spark = SparkSession.builder \
        .appName("ProactiveRebalancingPattern") \
        .config("spark.sql.adaptive.enabled", "true") \
        .config("spark.sql.adaptive.coalescePartitions.enabled", "true") \
        .config("spark.sql.shuffle.partitions", "16") \
        .getOrCreate()

    base_time = datetime(2024, 1, 1)
    data = []
    
    for i in range(50000):
        timestamp = base_time + timedelta(minutes=i)
        hour = timestamp.hour
        
        # Simulate varying load throughout the day
        if 9 <= hour <= 17:  # Business hours - high volume
            category = f"cat_{random.randint(1, 20)}"
            value = random.randint(100, 1000)
        elif 0 <= hour <= 6:  # Night - low volume
            category = f"cat_{random.randint(1, 5)}"
            value = random.randint(1, 100)
        else:  # Other hours - medium volume
            category = f"cat_{random.randint(1, 10)}"
            value = random.randint(50, 500)
        
        data.append((i, timestamp, category, value, hour))
    
    schema = StructType([
        StructField("id", IntegerType(), True),
        StructField("timestamp", TimestampType(), True),
        StructField("category", StringType(), True),
        StructField("value", IntegerType(), True),
        StructField("hour", IntegerType(), True)
    ])
    
    df = spark.createDataFrame(data, schema)
    
    # Strategy 1: Time-Based Proactive Rebalancing
    print("\n1. Time-Based Proactive Rebalancing:")
    print("-" * 60)
    
    class TimeBasedRebalancer:
        """Rebalancer that adjusts based on time patterns"""
        
        def __init__(self):
            self.partition_schedule = {
                'night': (0, 6, 4),      # hours 0-6: 4 partitions
                'morning': (7, 11, 12),  # hours 7-11: 12 partitions
                'peak': (12, 17, 24),    # hours 12-17: 24 partitions
                'evening': (18, 23, 8)   # hours 18-23: 8 partitions
            }
        
        def get_optimal_partitions(self, hour):
            """Get optimal partition count for given hour"""
            for period, (start, end, partitions) in self.partition_schedule.items():
                if start <= hour <= end:
                    return period, partitions
            return 'default', 8
        
        def rebalance_by_time(self, df):
            """Rebalance data based on time periods"""
            print("  Applying time-based partitioning...")
            
            # Add partition assignment based on hour
            df_with_partitions = df.withColumn(
                "partition_count",
                when((col("hour") >= 0) & (col("hour") <= 6), lit(4))
                .when((col("hour") >= 7) & (col("hour") <= 11), lit(12))
                .when((col("hour") >= 12) & (col("hour") <= 17), lit(24))
                .otherwise(lit(8))
            )
            
            # Analyze distribution
            time_distribution = df_with_partitions.groupBy("hour").agg(
                count("*").alias("record_count"),
                first("partition_count").alias("assigned_partitions")
            ).orderBy("hour")
            
            print("\n  Time-based partition assignment:")
            time_distribution.show(24, False)
            
            # Process each time period separately with optimal partitions
            results = []
            for period, (start, end, partitions) in self.partition_schedule.items():
                df_period = df.filter((col("hour") >= start) & (col("hour") <= end))
                df_period_rebalanced = df_period.repartition(partitions)
                
                count = df_period.count()
                print(f"  {period.capitalize()} period ({start}-{end}h): "
                      f"{count} records, {partitions} partitions")
                
                results.append(df_period_rebalanced)
            
            # Union all periods
            df_final = results[0]
            for df_period in results[1:]:
                df_final = df_final.union(df_period)
            
            return df_final
    
    time_rebalancer = TimeBasedRebalancer()
    df_time_balanced = time_rebalancer.rebalance_by_time(df)
    
    # Strategy 2: Predictive Load-Based Rebalancing
    print("\n2. Predictive Load-Based Rebalancing:")
    print("-" * 60)
    
    class PredictiveRebalancer:

            print("  Analyzing historical patterns...")
            
            # Aggregate by time windows

            ).orderBy("time_window")
            
            load_stats_collected = load_stats.collect()
            
            print(f"  Analyzed {len(load_stats_collected)} time windows")
            
            return load_stats_collected
        
        def predict_next_load(self, historical_data):
            """Predict load for next time window"""
            if len(historical_data) < 2
```python
:
                return None
            
            # Simple moving average prediction
            recent_loads = [row['total_records'] for row in historical_data[-self.prediction_window:]]
            predicted_load = sum(recent_loads) / len(recent_loads)
            
            # Calculate trend
            if len(recent_loads) >= 2:
                trend = (recent_loads[-1] - recent_loads[0]) / len(recent_loads)
            else:
                trend = 0
            
            # Adjust prediction based on trend
            predicted_load += trend * 2
            
            return max(0, int(predicted_load))
        
        def calculate_proactive_partitions(self, predicted_load, current_partitions):
            """Calculate partition count based on predicted load"""
            # Define load thresholds
            low_threshold = 1000
            medium_threshold = 5000
            high_threshold = 10000
            
            if predicted_load < low_threshold:
                recommended_partitions = 4
                reason = "Low predicted load"
            elif predicted_load < medium_threshold:
                recommended_partitions = 8
                reason = "Medium predicted load"
            elif predicted_load < high_threshold:
                recommended_partitions = 16
                reason = "High predicted load"
            else:
                recommended_partitions = 32
                reason = "Very high predicted load"
            
            # Smooth transitions - don't change too drastically
            if abs(recommended_partitions - current_partitions) > 8:
                if recommended_partitions > current_partitions:
                    recommended_partitions = current_partitions + 8
                else:
                    recommended_partitions = max(4, current_partitions - 8)
                reason += " (smoothed transition)"
            
            return recommended_partitions, reason
        
        def apply_predictive_rebalancing(self, df):
            """Apply rebalancing based on predictions"""
            print("  Applying predictive rebalancing...")
            
            # Analyze historical patterns
            historical_data = self.analyze_historical_patterns(df)
            
            # Predict next load
            predicted_load = self.predict_next_load(historical_data)
            
            if predicted_load:
                print(f"  Predicted load for next window: {predicted_load} records")
                
                # Calculate optimal partitions
                current_partitions = df.rdd.getNumPartitions()
                recommended_partitions, reason = self.calculate_proactive_partitions(
                    predicted_load, current_partitions
                )

                print(f"  Recommended partitions: {recommended_partitions}")
                print(f"  Reason: {reason}")
                
                # Apply rebalancing

                    if recommended_partitions > current_partitions:
                        df_rebalanced = df.repartition(recommended_partitions)
                        print(f"  ✓ Repartitioned to {recommended_partitions} partitions")
                    else:
                        df_rebalanced = df.coalesce(recommended_partitions)
                        print(f"  ✓ Coalesced to {recommended_partitions} partitions")
                    
                    return df_rebalanced
            
            return df

    # Strategy 3: Threshold-Based Proactive Monitoring
    print("\n3. Threshold-Based Proactive Monitoring:")
    print("-" * 60)
    
    class ThresholdMonitor:
        """Monitor metrics and trigger proactive rebalancing"""
        
        def __init__(self):
            self.thresholds = {
                'max_partition_size': 5000,
                'min_partition_size': 100,
                'cv_threshold': 0.5,
                'skew_ratio': 3.0
            }
            self.alerts = []
        
        def check_partition_health(self, df):
            """Check partition health against thresholds"""
            print("  Checking partition health...")
            
            # Get partition sizes
            partition_sizes = df.rdd.mapPartitionsWithIndex(
                lambda idx, it: [(idx, sum(1 for _ in it))]
            ).collect()
            
            sizes = [size for _, size in partition_sizes]
            
            if not sizes:
                return True, []
            
            # Calculate metrics
            avg_size = sum(sizes) / len(sizes)
            max_size = max(sizes)
            min_size = min(sizes)
            std_dev = (sum((x - avg_size) ** 2 for x in sizes) / len(sizes)) ** 0.5
            cv = std_dev / avg_size if avg_size > 0 else 0
            
            print(f"  Partition Metrics:")
            print(f"    Average size: {avg_size:.2f}")
            print(f"    Max size: {max_size}")
            print(f"    Min size: {min_size}")
            print(f"    CV: {cv:.2f}")
            
            # Check thresholds
            alerts = []
            healthy = True
            
            if max_size > self.thresholds['max_partition_size']:
                alerts.append(f"⚠ Max partition size ({max_size}) exceeds threshold ({self.thresholds['max_partition_size']})")
                healthy = False
            
            if min_size < self.thresholds['min_partition_size'] and min_size > 0:
                alerts.append(f"⚠ Min partition size ({min_size}) below threshold ({self.thresholds['min_partition_size']})")
                healthy = False
            
            if cv > self.thresholds['cv_threshold']:
                alerts.append(f"⚠ CV ({cv:.2f}) exceeds threshold ({self.thresholds['cv_threshold']})")
                healthy = False
            
            if min_size > 0 and (max_size / min_size) > self.thresholds['skew_ratio']:
                alerts.append(f"⚠ Skew ratio ({max_size/min_size:.2f}) exceeds threshold ({self.thresholds['skew_ratio']})")
                healthy = False
            
            if healthy:
                print("  ✓ All partitions are healthy")
            else:
                print("  ✗ Partition health issues detected:")
                for alert in alerts:
                    print(f"    {alert}")
            
            self.alerts.extend(alerts)
            return healthy, alerts
        
        def proactive_rebalance(self, df):
            """Proactively rebalance based on health check"""
            healthy, alerts = self.check_partition_health(df)
            
            if not healthy:
                print("\n  Applying proactive rebalancing...")
                
                # Determine rebalancing strategy based on alerts
                if any('CV' in alert or 'Skew' in alert for alert in alerts):
                    print("  Strategy: Round-robin repartitioning")
                    num_partitions = df.rdd.getNumPartitions()
                    df_rebalanced = df.repartition(num_partitions)
                elif any('Max partition' in alert for alert in alerts):
                    print("  Strategy: Increasing partitions")
                    num_partitions = df.rdd.getNumPartitions() * 2
                    df_rebalanced = df.repartition(num_partitions)
                elif any('Min partition' in alert for alert in alerts):
                    print("  Strategy: Coalescing partitions")
                    num_partitions = max(2, df.rdd.getNumPartitions() // 2)
                    df_rebalanced = df.coalesce(num_partitions)
                else:
                    df_rebalanced = df
                
                # Verify improvement
                healthy_after, _ = self.check_partition_health(df_rebalanced)
                if healthy_after:
                    print("  ✓ Rebalancing successful - partitions are now healthy")
                else:
                    print("  ⚠ Rebalancing applied but some issues remain")
                
                return df_rebalanced
            
            return df
    
    threshold_monitor = ThresholdMonitor()
    df_monitored = threshold_monitor.proactive_rebalance(df)
    
    # Strategy 4: Capacity Planning Rebalancing
    print("\n4. Capacity Planning Rebalancing:")
    print("-" * 60)
    
    class CapacityPlanner:
        """Plan capacity and rebalance proactively"""
        
        def __init__(self, cluster_cores=16, memory_per_executor_gb=4):
            self.cluster_cores = cluster_cores
            self.memory_per_executor_gb = memory_per_executor_gb
        
        def estimate_resource_requirements(self, df):
            """Estimate resource requirements for processing"""
            print("  Estimating resource requirements...")
            
            # Sample to estimate row size
            sample_df = df.limit(1000)
            sample_count = sample_df.count()
            
            # Rough estimation of memory per row (in bytes)
            # This is a simplified estimation
            estimated_row_size = 200  # bytes
            
            total_count = df.count()
            estimated_total_size_mb = (total_count * estimated_row_size) / (1024 * 1024)
            
            print(f"  Total records: {total_count}")
            print(f"  Estimated total size: {estimated_total_size_mb:.2f} MB")
            
            return total_count, estimated_total_size_mb
        
        def calculate_optimal_configuration(self, total_records, total_size_mb):
            """Calculate optimal partition and executor configuration"""
            print("\n  Calculating optimal configuration...")
            
            # Target partition size (128 MB is often optimal)
            target_partition_size_mb = 128
            
            # Calculate optimal partitions based on data size
            optimal_partitions_by_size = max(1, int(total_size_mb / target_partition_size_mb))
            
            # Calculate optimal partitions based on parallelism
            # Aim for 2-3 tasks per core
            optimal_partitions_by_cores = self.cluster_cores * 3
            
            # Take the minimum to avoid too many small partitions
            optimal_partitions = min(optimal_partitions_by_size, optimal_partitions_by_cores)
            
            # But ensure at least one partition per core
            optimal_partitions = max(optimal_partitions, self.cluster_cores)
            
            # Calculate records per partition
            records_per_partition = total_records / optimal_partitions
            
            print(f"  Cluster cores: {self.cluster_cores}")
            print(f"  Optimal partitions (by size): {optimal_partitions_by_size}")
            print(f"  Optimal partitions (by cores): {optimal_partitions_by_cores}")
            print(f"  Recommended partitions: {optimal_partitions}")
            print(f"  Expected records per partition: {records_per_partition:.0f}")
            
            return optimal_partitions
        
        def apply_capacity_based_rebalancing(self, df):
            """Apply rebalancing based on capacity planning"""
            total_records, total_size_mb = self.estimate_resource_requirements(df)
            optimal_partitions = self.calculate_optimal_configuration(total_records, total_size_mb)
            
            current_partitions = df.rdd.getNumPartitions()
            print(f"\n  Current partitions: {current_partitions}")
            print(f"  Applying capacity-based rebalancing to {optimal_partitions} partitions...")
            
            if optimal_partitions > current_partitions:
                df_rebalanced = df.repartition(optimal_partitions)
            elif optimal_partitions < current_partitions:
                df_rebalanced = df.coalesce(optimal_partitions)
            else:
                df_rebalanced = df
                print("  No rebalancing needed - already at optimal partition count")
            
            return df_rebalanced
    
    capacity_planner = CapacityPlanner(cluster_cores=16, memory_per_executor_gb=4)
    df_capacity_balanced = capacity_planner.apply_capacity_based_rebalancing(df)
    
    # Strategy 5: Pre-emptive Skew Prevention
    print("\n5. Pre-emptive Skew Prevention:")
    print("-" * 60)
    
    class SkewPreventer:
        """Prevent skew before it occurs"""
        
        def __init__(self, skew_threshold=0.2):
            self.skew_threshold = skew_threshold  # 20% of data in one key is considered skew
        
        def detect_potential_skew(self, df, key_column):
            """Detect potential skew in advance"""
            print(f"  Detecting potential skew on column: {key_column}")
            
            total_count = df.count()
            
            # Get key distribution
            key_dist = df.groupBy(key_column).agg(
                count("*").alias("count")
            ).withColumn(
                "percentage", (col("count") / lit(total_count)) * 100
            ).orderBy(desc("count"))
            
            # Identify skewed keys
            skewed_keys_df = key_dist.filter(col("percentage") > self.skew_threshold * 100)
            skewed_keys = skewed_keys_df.select(key_column).rdd.flatMap(lambda x: x).collect()
            
            if skewed_keys:
                print(f"  ⚠ Detected {len(skewed_keys)} potentially skewed keys:")
                skewed_keys_df.show(10, False)
            else:
                print(f"  ✓ No significant skew detected")
            
            return skewed_keys, key_dist
        
        def apply_preventive_salting(self, df, key_column, skewed_keys, num_salts=10):
            """Apply salting to prevent skew"""
            if not skewed_keys:
                print("  No salting needed")
                return df
            
            print(f"  Applying preventive salting with {num_salts} salts...")
            
            # Add salt column
            df_salted = df.withColumn(
                "is_skewed",
                when(col(key_column).isin(skewed_keys), lit(1)).otherwise(lit(0))
            ).withColumn(
                "salt",
                when(col("is_skewed") == 1, (rand() * num_salts).cast("int")).otherwise(lit(0))
            ).withColumn(
                "salted_key",
                when(col("is_skewed") == 1, 
                     concat(col(key_column), lit("_salt_"), col("salt")))
                .otherwise(col(key_column))
            )
            
            # Repartition on salted key
            df_rebalanced = df_salted.repartition(num_salts * 2, "salted_key")
            
            print(f"  ✓ Applied preventive salting and repartitioned")
            
            return df_rebalanced
        
        def proactive_skew_prevention(self, df, key_column):
            """Complete proactive skew prevention workflow"""
            skewed_keys, distribution = self.detect_potential_skew(df, key_column)
            
            if skewed_keys:
                df_prevented = self.apply_preventive_salting(df, key_column, skewed_keys)
                return df_prevented
            
            return df

    class ScheduledRebalancer:
        """Perform scheduled rebalancing at optimal times"""
        
        def __init__(self):
            self.maintenance_windows = {
                'daily': {'hour': 3, 'duration_minutes': 30},
                'weekly': {'day': 'Sunday', 'hour': 2, 'duration_minutes': 60},
                'monthly': {'day': 1, 'hour': 1, 'duration_minutes': 120}
            }
            self.last_rebalance = None
        
        def is_maintenance_window(self, current_time, window_type='daily'):
            """Check if current time is within maintenance window"""
            window = self.maintenance_windows.get(window_type, self.maintenance_windows['daily'])
            
            if window_type == 'daily':
                return current_time.hour == window['hour']
            elif window_type == 'weekly':
                return (current_time.strftime('%A') == window['day'] and 
                       current_time.hour == window['hour'])
            elif window_type == 'monthly':
                return (current_time.day == window['day'] and 
                       current_time.hour == window['hour'])
            
            return False
        
        def perform_maintenance_rebalancing(self, df, current_time=None):
            """Perform comprehensive rebalancing during maintenance window"""
            if current_time is None:
                current_time = datetime.now()
            
            print(f"  Current time: {current_time}")
            
            # Check if in maintenance window
            if self.is_maintenance_window(current_time, 'daily'):
                print("  ✓ In daily maintenance window - performing rebalancing")
                
                # Comprehensive rebalancing steps
                print("\n  Step 1: Analyzing current state...")
                current_partitions = df.rdd.getNumPartitions()
                total_records = df.count()
                
                print(f"    Current partitions: {current_partitions}")
                print(f"    Total records: {total_records}")
                
                # Step 2: Calculate optimal partitions
                print("\n  Step 2: Calculating optimal configuration...")
                optimal_partitions = max(4, min(32, total_records // 2000))
                print(f"    Optimal partitions: {optimal_partitions}")
                
                # Step 3: Repartition
                print("\n  Step 3: Repartitioning data...")
                df_rebalanced = df.repartition(optimal_partitions)
                
                # Step 4: Sort within partitions for better compression
                print("\n  Step 4: Sorting within partitions...")
                df_rebalanced = df_rebalanced.sortWithinPartitions("timestamp", "category")
                
                # Step 5: Cache for subsequent operations
                print("\n  Step 5: Caching optimized DataFrame...")
                df_rebalanced.cache()
                df_rebalanced.count()  # Materialize cache
                
                print("\n  ✓ Maintenance rebalancing completed successfully")
                self.last_rebalance = current_time
                
                return df_rebalanced
            else:
                print("  ℹ Not in maintenance window - skipping rebalancing")
                return df
        
        def get_next_maintenance_window(self, current_time=None):
            """Calculate next maintenance window"""
            if current_time is None:
                current_time = datetime.now()
            
            next_window = current_time.replace(
                hour=self.maintenance_windows['daily']['hour'],
                minute=0,
                second=0,
                microsecond=0
            )
            
            if next_window <= current_time:

    class IntelligentCacheManager:
        """Manage caching with proactive rebalancing"""
        
        def __init__(self):
            self.cached_dataframes = {}
            self.access_patterns = {}
        
        def should_cache(self, df, access_count=1):
            """Determine if DataFrame should be cached"""
            # Cache if accessed multiple times or expensive to compute
            return access_count > 1
        
        def cache_with_rebalancing(self, df, name, optimize=True):
            """Cache DataFrame with optional rebalancing"""
            print(f"  Caching DataFrame: {name}")
            
            if optimize:
                print("  Optimizing before caching...")
                
                # Check current partition health
                partition_sizes = df.rdd.mapPartitionsWithIndex(
                    lambda idx, it: [(idx, sum(1 for _ in it))]
                ).collect()
                
                sizes = [size for _, size in partition_sizes]
                if sizes:
                    avg_size = sum(sizes) / len(sizes)
                    max_size = max(sizes)
                    cv = (sum((x - avg_size) ** 2 for x in sizes) / len(sizes)) ** 0.5 / avg_size if avg_size > 0 else 0
                    
                    print(f"    Current CV: {cv:.2f}")
                    
                    # Rebalance if needed before caching
                    if cv > 0.3:
                        print("    Rebalancing before cache...")
                        num_partitions = len(sizes)
                        df = df.repartition(num_partitions)
                        print("    ✓ Rebalanced")
            
            # Cache the DataFrame
            df.cache()
            count = df.count()  # Materialize
            
            self.cached_dataframes[name] = {
                'dataframe': df,
                'cached_at': datetime.now(),
                'record_count': count,
                'access_count': 0
            }
            
            print(f"  ✓ Cached {count} records")
            
            return df
        
        def access_cached_df(self, name):
            """Access cached DataFrame and track usage"""
            if name in self.cached_dataframes:
                self.cached_dataframes[name]['access_count'] += 1
                print(f"  Accessing cached DataFrame: {name} "
                      f"(access count: {self.cached_dataframes[name]['access_count']})")
                return self.cached_dataframes[name]['dataframe']
            return None
        
        def evict_stale_caches(self, max_age_minutes=60):
            """Evict caches that are too old"""
            print("  Checking for stale caches...")
            current_time = datetime.now()
            
            stale_caches = []
            for name, info in self.cached_dataframes.items():
                age_minutes = (current_time - info['cached_at']).total_seconds() / 60
                if age_minutes > max_age_minutes:
                    stale_caches.append(name)
            
            for name in stale_caches:
                print(f"    Evicting stale cache: {name}")
                self.cached_dataframes[name]['dataframe'].unpersist()
                del self.cached_dataframes[name]
            
            if stale_caches:
                print(f"  ✓ Evicted {len(stale_caches)} stale caches")
            else:
                print("  ✓ No stale caches found")
    
    cache_manager = IntelligentCacheManager()
    
    # Cache with optimization
    df_cached = cache_manager.cache_with_rebalancing(df, "main_dataset", optimize=True)
    
    # Simulate multiple accesses
    cache_manager.access_cached_df("main_dataset")
    cache_manager.access_cached_df("main_dataset")

    class ProactiveMonitoringSystem:
        """Continuous monitoring with proactive alerts"""
        
        def __init__(self):
            self.metrics_history = []
            self.alert_thresholds = {
                'partition_cv': 0.5,
                'processing_time_increase': 1.5,
                'memory_usage': 0.8,
                'skew_ratio': 3.0
            }
        
        def collect_metrics(self, df, stage_name):
            """Collect comprehensive metrics"""
            start_time = time.time()
            
            # Partition metrics
            partition_sizes = df.rdd.mapPartitionsWithIndex(
                lambda idx, it: [(idx, sum(1 for _ in it))]
            ).collect()
            
            sizes = [size for _, size in partition_sizes]
            
            if sizes:
                avg_size = sum(sizes) / len(sizes)
                std_dev = (sum((x - avg_size) ** 2 for x in sizes) / len(sizes)) ** 0.5
                cv = std_dev / avg_size if avg_size > 0 else 0
                max_size = max(sizes)
                min_size = min(sizes)
            else:
                avg_size = std_dev = cv = max_size = min_size = 0
            
            collection_time = time.time() - start_time
            
            metrics = {
                'timestamp': datetime.now(),
                'stage': stage_name,
                'num_partitions': len(sizes),
                'avg_partition_size': avg_size,
                'cv': cv,
                'max_size': max_size,
                'min_size': min_size,
                'skew_ratio': max_size / min_size if min_size > 0 else 0,
                'collection_time': collection_time
            }
            
            self.metrics_history.append(metrics)
            return metrics
        
        def check_alerts(self, current_metrics):
            """Check for alert conditions"""
            alerts = []
            
            # Check CV threshold
            if current_metrics['cv'] > self.alert_thresholds['partition_cv']:
                alerts.append({
                    'severity': 'WARNING',
                    'type': 'HIGH_PARTITION_VARIANCE',
                    'message': f"Partition CV ({current_metrics['cv']:.2f}) exceeds threshold",
                    'recommendation': 'Consider repartitioning with round-robin strategy'
                })
            
            # Check skew ratio
            if current_metrics['skew_ratio'] > self.alert_thresholds['skew_ratio']:
                alerts.append({
                    'severity': 'WARNING',
                    'type': 'PARTITION_SKEW',
                    'message': f"Skew ratio ({current_metrics['skew_ratio']:.2f}) exceeds threshold",
                    'recommendation': 'Apply salting or isolated broadcast strategy'
                })
            
            # Check for trend degradation
            if len(self.metrics_history) > 1:
                prev_metrics = self.metrics_history[-2]
                if current_metrics['cv'] > prev_metrics['cv'] * 1.3:
                    alerts.append({
                        'severity': 'INFO',
                        'type': 'DEGRADING_BALANCE',
                        'message': 'Partition balance is degrading
```python
',
                        'recommendation': 'Schedule proactive rebalancing'
                    })
            
            return alerts
        
        def display_monitoring_dashboard(self):

            print("\n  PROACTIVE MONITORING DASHBOARD")

            print("\n  Recent Metrics:")

                print("  " + "-" * 76)
                
                first = self.metrics_history[0]
                last = self.metrics_history[-1]
                
                cv_trend = ((last['cv'] - first['cv']) / first['cv'] * 100) if first['cv'] > 0 else 0
                skew_trend = ((last['skew_ratio'] - first['skew_ratio']) / first['skew_ratio'] * 100) if first['skew_ratio'] > 0 else 0
                
                print(f"  CV Trend: {cv_trend:+.1f}%")
                print(f"  Skew Ratio Trend: {skew_trend:+.1f}%")
                
                if cv_trend > 20:

                elif cv_trend < -20:
                    print("  ✓ Good: Partition balance is improving")
            
            # Active alerts

            if alerts:

    class AutoHealingRebalancer:
        """Automatically detect and fix rebalancing issues"""
        
        def __init__(self):
            self.healing_history = []
            self.max_healing_attempts = 3
        
        def diagnose_issue(self, df):
            """Diagnose rebalancing issues"""
            print("  Diagnosing partition health...")
            
            partition_sizes = df.rdd.mapPartitionsWithIndex(
                lambda idx, it: [(idx, sum(1 for _ in it))]
            ).collect()
            
            sizes = [size for _, size in partition_sizes]
            
            if not sizes:
                return None, "No data"
            
            avg_size = sum(sizes) / len(sizes)
            max_size = max(sizes)
            min_size = min(sizes)
            std_dev = (sum((x - avg_size) ** 2 for x in sizes) / len(sizes)) ** 0.5
            cv = std_dev / avg_size if avg_size > 0 else 0
            
            # Diagnose specific issues
            issues = []
            
            if cv > 0.5:
                issues.append({
                    'type': 'HIGH_VARIANCE',
                    'severity': 'MEDIUM',
                    'metric': cv,
                    'threshold': 0.5,
                    'healing_strategy': 'round_robin_repartition'
                })
            
            if min_size > 0 and (max_size / min_size) > 4:
                issues.append({
                    'type': 'SEVERE_SKEW',
                    'severity': 'HIGH',
                    'metric': max_size / min_size,
                    'threshold': 4,
                    'healing_strategy': 'salting'
                })
            
            if min_size == 0:
                issues.append({
                    'type': 'EMPTY_PARTITIONS',
                    'severity': 'MEDIUM',
                    'metric': sizes.count(0),
                    'threshold': 0,
                    'healing_strategy': 'coalesce'
                })
            
            if max_size > 10000:
                issues.append({
                    'type': 'OVERSIZED_PARTITION',
                    'severity': 'HIGH',
                    'metric': max_size,
                    'threshold': 10000,
                    'healing_strategy': 'increase_partitions'
                })
            
            return issues, sizes
        
        def apply_healing(self, df, issue):
            """Apply appropriate healing strategy"""
            strategy = issue['healing_strategy']
            
            print(f"  Applying healing strategy: {strategy}")
            print(f"    Issue: {issue['type']}")
            print(f"    Severity: {issue['severity']}")
            
            if strategy == 'round_robin_repartition':
                num_partitions = df.rdd.getNumPartitions()
                df_healed = df.repartition(num_partitions)
                print(f"    ✓ Applied round-robin repartitioning")
            
            elif strategy == 'salting':
                # Simple salting approach
                num_salts = 8
                df_healed = df.withColumn("salt", (rand() * num_salts).cast("int")) \
                           .repartition(df.rdd.getNumPartitions() * 2, "salt") \
                           .drop("salt")
                print(f"    ✓ Applied salting with {num_salts} salts")
            
            elif strategy == 'coalesce':
                current_partitions = df.rdd.getNumPartitions()
                target_partitions = max(2, current_partitions // 2)
                df_healed = df.coalesce(target_partitions)
                print(f"    ✓ Coalesced to {target_partitions} partitions")
            
            elif strategy == 'increase_partitions':
                current_partitions = df.rdd.getNumPartitions()
                target_partitions = current_partitions * 2
                df_healed = df.repartition(target_partitions)
                print(f"    ✓ Increased to {target_partitions} partitions")
            
            else:
                df_healed = df
                print(f"    ⚠ Unknown strategy, no healing applied")
            
            return df_healed
        
        def auto_heal(self, df):
            """Automatically detect and heal issues"""
            print("  Starting auto-healing process...")
            
            attempt = 0
            current_df = df
            
            while attempt < self.max_healing_attempts:
                attempt += 1
                print(f"\n  Healing Attempt {attempt}/{self.max_healing_attempts}")
                print("  " + "-" * 76)
                
                # Diagnose
                issues, sizes = self.diagnose_issue(current_df)
                
                if not issues:
                    print("  ✓ No issues detected - system is healthy")
                    break
                
                # Sort issues by severity
                severity_order = {'HIGH': 0, 'MEDIUM': 1, 'LOW': 2}
                issues.sort(key=lambda x: severity_order.get(x['severity'], 3))
                
                print(f"  Detected {len(issues)} issue(s):")
                for issue in issues:
                    print(f"    - {issue['type']} (Severity: {issue['severity']})")
                
                # Heal the most severe issue
                most_severe = issues[0]
                current_df = self.apply_healing(current_df, most_severe)
                
                # Record healing action
                self.healing_history.append({
                    'timestamp': datetime.now(),
                    'attempt': attempt,
                    'issue': most_severe['type'],
                    'strategy': most_severe['healing_strategy']
                })
                
                # Verify healing
                issues_after, sizes_after = self.diagnose_issue(current_df)
                
                if not issues_after:
                    print(f"\n  ✓ Auto-healing successful after {attempt} attempt(s)")
                    break
                elif len(issues_after) < len(issues):
                    print(f"  ↗ Partial improvement ({len(issues)} → {len(issues_after)} issues)")
                else:
                    print(f"  → No improvement, trying different approach")
            
            if attempt >= self.max_healing_attempts:
                print(f"\n  ⚠ Max healing attempts reached, manual intervention may be required")
            
            return current_df
        
        def print_healing_report(self):
            """Print healing history report"""
            if not self.healing_history:
                print("  No healing actions performed")
                return
            
            print("\n  AUTO-HEALING REPORT")
            print("  " + "=" * 76)
            print(f"  {'Timestamp':<20} {'Attempt':<10} {'Issue':<25} {'Strategy':<20}")
            print("  " + "-" * 76)
            
            for action in self.healing_history:
                timestamp_str = action['timestamp'].strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
                print(f"  {timestamp_str:<20} {action['attempt']:<10} "
                      f"{action['issue']:<25} {action['strategy']:<20}")
    
    # Test auto-healing
    auto_healer = AutoHealingRebalancer()
    
    # Create intentionally problematic DataFrame
    print("  Creating test DataFrame with issues...")
    df_problematic = df.repartition(20, "category")  # This may create skew
    
    # Apply auto-healing
    df_healed = auto_healer.auto_heal(df_problematic)
    
    # Print healing report
    auto_healer.print_healing_report()
    
    # Final Summary and Best Practices
    print("\n" + "=" * 80)
    print("PROACTIVE REBALANCING PATTERN - COMPREHENSIVE SUMMARY")

# Example 1: Simple Partition Rebalancing
def example_partition_rebalancing():
    """Basic partition rebalancing after filter"""
    from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
    
    spark = SparkSession.builder.appName("Example").getOrCreate()
    
    # Load data
    df = spark.read.parquet("s3://bucket/data")
    
    # Filter reduces data by 80%
    df_filtered = df.filter("status = 'active'")
    
    # Rebalance partitions
    original_partitions = df_filtered.rdd.getNumPartitions()
    target_partitions = max(4, original_partitions // 5)
    df_rebalanced = df_filtered.coalesce(target_partitions)
    
    return df_rebalanced

        when(col("product_id").isin(skewed_keys),

    df_small_normal = df_small.filter(~col("product_id").isin(skewed_keys)) \
